title: a value without string() cannot reach a ...string tail
purpose: Only values whose type answers string() with a string are converted; any other value is rejected before the program runs.

rejection.justification: Blank has no string() action, so no writeln signature accepts it; the checker rejects the call, and the first line never prints.

provenance.origin: authored for the text conversion of ...string tails
provenance.expected_basis: Book 18.4: the conversion needs string() is string on the value's type.
